title: Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this pump application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by pump shaft protective wear sleeve (grade 5) and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining from plate for pump geometry
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces
commonFailures: Weld zone preferential attack in chlorinated water - controlled by post-weld pickling and proper filler selection

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve suitable for Pump shaft protective wear sleeve (Grade 5)?
faq.a: Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address pump operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. pump components receive Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Shaft sleeve / Wear sleeve pump components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
